correctness.rationale: Bessel differentiation makes the bipyramid slice kernel convex up to the first positive zero of an explicit Bessel combination; a self-contained half-wave pairing argument makes its cosine transform strictly positive. Endpoint cases and the dimension-three rational certification were checked separately.

originality.rationale: The motivating September 2026 preprint proves only existence of a strip, records no explicit constants, and leaves fixed-pair certification to future work. Targeted literature and archive searches found no Bessel-root strip, all-dimensional threshold, or analytic (100,3) certification.

value.rationale: The result replaces a qualitative compactness constant with a one-dimensional Bessel-root certificate, gives an explicit counterexample threshold in every dimension d>=3, and rigorously resolves a concrete fixed pair highlighted by the source paper.
